metadata.title: AMD's stock ends the day 7% higher heading into earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
Aug. 4, 4:10pm ET
AMD's stock ends the day 7% higher heading into earnings
Shares of Advanced Micro Devices closed 7% higher on Tuesday ahead of the company's second-quarter earnings report, which is expected around 4:15 p.m. Eastern time.
Other chip stocks also finished solidly in the green, with Marvell Technology up 12.8%, Intel up 10.8%, Broadcom up 6.6% and Nvidia up 2.5%.
Memory makers Sandisk and Micron Technology saw their stocks rise 10.8% and 7.6%, respectively.
